text:
Alex: Heads-up — Datadog marketplace tile needs final QA before we lift embargo next week. Running a partner-run-through on Wed 10am PT. Can people list must-pass checks?
Maria: Thanks — big ones: dashboard templates, sample data obfuscation, and exporter install doc.
Sam: Also GPU-specific metrics: NVML per-process GPU util, memory_mib, and per-inference latency histograms. We had a missing tag on batch_id last time.
Jie: Agree. Also ensure trace spans include model_id and quantization_tag so customers can correlate perf vs quality.
Paul: Legal ask: confirm no PII in sample payloads. Maria can you confirm synthetic dataset is scrubbed and has provenance note?
Maria: Yep — scrubbed. We replaced email/userids with hashed tokens and added README explaining the substitution. Will attach sample manifest.
IntegrationsBot: reminder: marketplace embargo window: 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC to 2026-04-03 20:00 UTC. Do not publish during window.
Alex: For the onprem/airgapped flow we need a small CLI snippet that shows how to configure an HEC (Datadog intake) fallback. Sam can you paste the minimal config?
Sam: sure — gist:```yaml
exporter:
  datadog:
    endpoint: "https://api.datadoghq.com"
    api_key_env: DD_API_KEY
    fallback_file: "/var/log/redwood/dd-fallback.log"
    headers:
      X-Model: "{{model_id}}"
```
Jie: Nice. Also add a note to rotate the api key and to use a read-only key for telemetry where possible.
Paul: On SI side — we should provide a bite-sized acceptance test for partners: 1) start the model, 2) send 100 synthetic requests, 3) confirm traces show at least one span with batch_size>1 and model_id tag, 4) dashboard shows GPU mem spike. Can someone draft the script?
Sam: I can draft a small mocha script that hits the hosted demo. Will upload to the repo under /integrations/marketplace/acceptance.
Maria: UX note: dashboard tile needs a compact legend for GPU memory and request-latency p95. Datadog tile panels currently crowd the canvas; reduce to 4 panels.
Alex: Good call. Also we need a short runbook for incident handoff to Datadog SI — include logs to attach, export window, and high-level troubleshooting steps (check exporter, check TLS certs, check HEC ingestion). I'll draft.
Jie: Privacy/regulatory: for EU customers we must show that telemetry sampling and retention can be configured per-customer. Add to docs: how to set sampling rules and retention via the console + example curl.
Maria: I'll update the README with sampling examples and point to the privacy FAQ.
IntegrationsBot: action created: #PR-834 (dashboard polish) assigned to Maria; due 2026-03-28.
Paul: One more: verify that the marketplace bundle installs the correct pin of the tracing lib (we had a regression when agent bumped to 1.6). Lock to 1.5.x for the package in the bundle manifest.
Sam: noted — will pin in the package.json and e2e test.
Alex: OK — owner list: Maria (docs + dashboard), Sam (acceptance script + exporter snippets), Jie (traces + sampling docs), Paul (legal + SI checklist). We'll meet Wed 10am PT for the partner-runthrough. If anything blocks before that, drop updates here.
Maria: LG, I'll upload scrubbed sample manifest + screenshot by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: Will open PR for the script later today.
Jie: Drafting sampling curl examples now.
Paul: I'll ping legal for final signoff after Maria uploads manifest.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Quick note: keep messages short during the runthrough, capture timecodes for failed steps, and tag me if you hit a hard blocker. :pray:
